# RUVTIER

> RUVTIER is a luxury fashion house devoted to permanence, material origin, and the quiet art of garment composition.

RUVTIER composes garments from rare fibres — vicuña, cashmere, merino wool, silk, French linen, and selvedge denim — with an editorial sensibility inspired by the heritage of quiet luxury. The house publishes seasonal collections, material studies, and rituals of care alongside its online boutique.

## Materials

- [Vicuña](/materials/vicuna): The rarest fibre on earth, gathered once a year from the high Andes.
- [Cashmere](/materials/cashmere): Highland goat underfleece.
- [Merino Wool](/materials/merino-wool): Fine-gauge merino bred for softness.
- [Silk](/materials/silk): A filament born from stillness.
- [French Linen](/materials/french-linen): Linen grown in the fields of Normandy.
- [Denim](/materials/denim): Selvedge denim woven on heritage shuttle looms.
